demoTitle: Range Rover (L460, 2022 on): JLR MLA-Flex platform, EVA 2.0 electrical architecture, Pivi Pro infotainment with software-over-the-air updates. PHEV: P460e / P550e, 38.2 kWh battery (MY24 on). Premium software from JLR-listed features: Dynamic Response Pro (48 V active roll control), all-wheel steering, Meridian Signature Sound, Cabin Air Purification Pro, head-up display (option), 3D surround camera and Remote Park Assist. Voice: Amazon Alexa. Digital key is not confirmed for the L460 and is out of scope. Tier-1 development is a modelling assumption, not JLR's sourcing.

stepDetail: 1. Scope — 52 modules. 7 software domains on a PHEV vehicle; nominal effort 2,472 person-months (fresh code, QM, medium complexity).
2. Development effort — 2,779 PM. Reuse, complexity and the ISO 26262 ASIL uplift applied to each module: 2,472 → 2,779 PM. 18 modules at ASIL C/D (lit).
3. Verification & integration — +2,027 PM. SIL / MIL / HIL testing, integration, ISO/SAE 21434 cybersecurity and calibration: 4,806 PM of engineering in all. 20 modules at CAL3/4 (lit).

4. Engineering rate — £10,267 / PM. United Kingdom: 55 % senior blend of the hub's mid and senior rates; mid £6,237 / senior £6,531 per person-month (salary + statutory on-cost ÷ productive hours × 152 h), × development source price × 1.61 engineering burden.
5. Engineering cost (NRE) — £68.8M. Effort × rate = £49.3M; tools £15.8M, homologation £3.7M. Largest domain: Infotainment, Connectivity & UX £115.7M (all costs).
6. Lifecycle — £234.5M. Maintenance £33.9M, cloud £103.2M, licences and royalties £97.4M — paid over the 6 production years and the service years after the last build (to programme year 16).
7. Per vehicle — £253. NRE £68.8M over 1,200,000 vehicles (6-year recovery) + lifecycle over 1,200,000 vehicles. Programme total £303.3M.
